title: Dashboard enhancements
body:
* **Private bookmarks**: Dashboard viewers can now save filter combinations as private bookmarks to return to later. Private bookmarks are visible only to the user who creates them. See [Save a private bookmark](/aws/en/dashboards/manage#private-bookmarks).
* **Bulk import from Power BI and Tableau**: Genie Code can now import up to 100 Power BI or Tableau files at a time as AI/BI dashboards and metric views. See [Import multiple files in bulk](/aws/en/dashboards/manage/import-bi#bulk-import).
* **Field picker tooltips**: Hovering over a field or measure name in the field picker now shows its full name in a tooltip.
* **Layered combo charts**: Authors can now build combo charts from separate chart layers. See [Combo chart](/aws/en/dashboards/manage/visualizations/types#combo).
* **Custom waterfall totals**: Authors can now customize totals on waterfall charts. See [Waterfall chart](/aws/en/dashboards/manage/visualizations/types#waterfall).
* **Sankey label improvements**: Labels on Sankey diagrams now overlap less.
